description: 4-agent technical documentation & visual architecture pod (Team Lead, Technical Writer, Diagram & Visual Showcase Specialist, Read-Only Technical/UX Auditor) with source-code-grounded authoring and skeptical two-tier verification loops.
name: Technical Documentation & Visual Architecture Team

roles.responsibilities: Align Information Architecture (IA) and deliverable scope across Writer and Visualizer, oversee the parallel authoring and Auditor verification loops, and serve as sole external communication bridge.
roles.title: Team Leader

roles.responsibilities: Author publication-grade Markdown documentation (READMEs, architecture specs, CLI/API references, runbooks) grounded 100% in live source code, coordinate terminology with Visualizer, and resolve Auditor punchlists.
roles.title: Technical Writer

roles.responsibilities: Author self-contained interactive HTML architecture showcases, inline SVG diagrams, and Mermaid diagrams aligned with Writer's specs and live source code, and resolve Auditor visual/technical punchlists.
roles.title: Diagram & Visual Showcase Specialist

roles.responsibilities: Conduct skeptical Tier-1 (UX/readability/visual layout) and Tier-2 (source-code CLI/schema/invariant accuracy) audits of all documentation and visual deliverables; bounce defects directly to Writer/Visualizer before certifying approval to Lead.
roles.title: Technical Accuracy & UX Auditor

when_to_use: Ideal for authoring or overhauling project READMEs, deep-dive technical architecture specifications, API/CLI guides, and interactive HTML/SVG visual architecture showcases verified strictly against the as-implemented codebase.
workflow_summary: 1. Lead <-> Writer & Visualizer (Outline & source-of-truth alignment) -> 2. Writer & Visualizer (Parallel drafting + cross-sync) -> 3. Writer/Visualizer <-> Auditor (Two-tier UX & source-code accuracy audit + direct fix loops) -> 4. Auditor -> Lead (Final Sign-Off).
